TASK 03

IFTTT + Adafruit IO Automation

Understanding trigger-based IoT automation and the connection between cloud services and connected devices.

01

Overview

This task focuses on the concept of automation in IoT systems, where an event can initiate a predefined action.

02

Concepts

IFTTT

A platform designed around trigger-and-action workflows.

Trigger

An event that starts an automation workflow.

Action

The operation performed after the trigger.

Cloud IoT

Cloud services can connect device information and automation.
